prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a sunlit autumn park with orange trees, a stone bridge with a waist-high parapet and a standard bench on a leaf-strewn path, evenly lit by soft overcast light, shadows very soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in soft overcast daylight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Norwegian woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, fair skin with a light scatter of freckles, strong straight defined dark-blonde brows, warm bronze shadow across the lids, a fine brown liner, long lashes, large pale-blue eyes with bright real catchlights, soft contour, a muted red-brown lip, a fierce, steady, commanding expression, icy platinum-blonde hair styled in an intricate fishtail braid, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long brass chain ending in one large faceted topaz drop, and on the other ear a large bronze hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on bronze chains of different lengths (a silver chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a gold ship's anchor), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and two to three silver necklaces. RIGHT: ONE real adult Vietnamese woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, soft porcelain skin, delicate rose-pink eyeshadow, glossy soft-coral lips, icy platinum-blonde hair styled in cornrows braided tight against the scalp, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large copper hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on copper chains of different lengths (a lead hammer head, a silver ship's anchor, a copper teardrop-shaped sinker), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a single long silver chain ending in one large faceted emerald drop with a heavy rough silver a small flared temple bell hanging at its end, and an extreme maximalist stack of well over ten platinum anklets. RIGHT Outfit: Her skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a brown leather cowboy hat, a red bandana knotted at her neck and a silver sheriff star pinned on a thin leather neck strap, a tiny brown leather micro-bikini top of two small opaque triangle cups on thin strings tied at the neck and back, fully covering her bust, and a minimal brown leather micro bikini bottom of one tiny low-rise opaque triangle on thin side strings tied at the hips, the small opaque piece fully covering her, her stomach fully visible.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material glowing softly under the diffused light, the gentle light modelling every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
